name: Minamoto clan
alt: Minamoto no Yoritomo's government at Kamakura

predecessors.name: Heian Japan
predecessors.text: the Kantō with Kai (Yamanashi): Yoritomo's base at Kamakura and the Takeda of Kai who joined him, as the heian-japan dossier draws the zone

successors.name: Kamakura shogunate
successors.text: the Kantō with Kai (Yamanashi): Yoritomo's base at Kamakura and the Takeda of Kai who joined him, as the heian-japan dossier draws the zone

ledger.x: 1180: the Minamoto rise in the east.
1185: Yoritomo's government becomes the Kamakura bakufu.

wars.name: Genpei War
wars.outcome: Minamoto victory: the Taira were destroyed at Dan-no-ura on 25 April 1185 and Yoritomo's government took the realm, with shugo and jitō appointed in December 1185.

wars.name: Battle of Fujigawa
wars.outcome: Minamoto victory on 9 November 1180: the Taira withdrew.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the Kantō and Kai are the researcher's reading of the provinces the pages name.
